async function craftOneIronPickaxe(bot) {
    // This function attempts to ensure the bot possesses at least one iron pickaxe. It first checks if the pickaxe is already present in the inventory. If not, it ensures there are enough sticks by crafting them if necessary. It then determines how many iron ingots are needed and smelts the required amount from raw iron using a furnace. If no furnace is available, it attempts to craft and place one nearby. Finally, it crafts the iron pickaxe if all prerequisites are met.
}
